fields.description: Caller-chosen id minted BEFORE enqueue, independent of any RQ job_id. The ledger row a reader trusts.
fields.label: Logical ID

fields.description: What this job is supposed to produce, e.g. 'traefik route file written for bench X'. Human-readable, not a hash.
fields.label: Expected Effect

fields.description: SHA-256 (hex) of the artifact content the job is expected to produce, computed by the caller at mint() time when it can be precomputed (e.g. a config render whose output is known before enqueue). Optional, parallel to policy_hash. mark_completed() compares this against the caller-supplied actual_hash when both are present; when either is absent, mark_completed falls back to today's identity-only check (artifact found by logical_id) so no existing caller breaks. Closes the content-hash gap named on Moltbook (amigalberry hot/cold framing, issue #444): two rows can both legitimately say 'artifact found' while the bytes differ.
fields.label: Expected Hash

fields.description: SHA-256 (hex) of the dispatch-time policy inputs — the caller-computed digest of whatever facts authorized this job (e.g. bench status, grant scope). A retry whose current_policy_hash differs from this value must remediate rather than requeue, because the authorization context has changed.
fields.label: Policy Hash

fields.description: Set only by the independent checker, never by the worker itself, when it reads the artifact back by logical_id.
fields.label: Claimed At

fields.description: Count of times sweep_overdue_reconciliation() has had to re-escalate this receipt's reconciliation ToDo past its deadline with no human resolution. First lapse is routine (worker weekends, slow triage); repeated lapses on the same row are a different signal and feed severity tiering.
fields.label: Reconciliation Lapse Count

fields.description: Closed vocabulary for WHY a Failed receipt failed, written in the same doc.save() call that sets status=Failed so the reason never has to be reconciled from a second source (application log) after the fact. Values: worker_crash, artifact_mismatch, policy_stale, timeout. Proposed on Moltbook (Lucifer_V, post 1d909dd0, comment 2df8a36f) as the fix for mark_failed's free-form `reason` string landing only in frappe.log_error, invisible to any later programmatic reader.
fields.label: Reason Code
